# Level 1 - model comparison (auto-generated by src/final_comparison.py)

Validation: 2017-07-01 -> 2017-07-30, **53,460 rows, the same rows for every model.** The test slice (31 Jul - 15 Aug 2017) is NOT used here.
Scores use the same code for all models; predictions are clipped to 0. WAPE is the main metric.

| model | kind | MAE | RMSE | WAPE % | better than naive % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RandomForest | model | 62.30 | 219.30 | 12.75 | +27.2 |
| XGBoost | model | 67.47 | 260.20 | 13.81 | +21.1 |
| PolynomialRegression | model | 79.10 | 250.38 | 16.19 | +7.5 |
| NaiveBaseline (same as 21 days ago) | baseline | 85.54 | 318.98 | 17.50 | +0.0 |
| LinearRegression | model | 86.77 | 269.53 | 17.76 | -1.4 |

`experiment` rows are extra runs of the Polynomial model (not part of the agreed 5 models). `better than naive` = how much lower the WAPE is than the baseline.

## Residual analysis of the best official model: RandomForest

- **Bias:** total predicted / total actual = 1.013 (no clear over- or under-prediction).
- **Concentration:** the worst 1% of rows cause 26% of the total error.
- **By series size** (series sorted by total sales, in 4 equal groups):
  - smallest 25%: 4% of the error, WAPE 737.2%
  - 25-50%: 2% of the error, WAPE 39.2%
  - 50-75%: 10% of the error, WAPE 19.8%
  - biggest 25%: 84% of the error, WAPE 11.6%
- **Product families** with the largest share of the error: BEVERAGES (24%, WAPE 13%), GROCERY I (22%, WAPE 10%), CLEANING (12%, WAPE 18%), PRODUCE (10%, WAPE 8%), DAIRY (5%, WAPE 11%).
- **Stores** with the largest share of the error: store 44 (3%), store 45 (3%), store 49 (3%), store 47 (3%), store 40 (3%).
- **Over time:** the best day has WAPE 10.6% (2017-07-01), the worst 15.8% (2017-07-13).
- **Normal days:** WAPE 12.7% on 52,767 rows.
- **Holidays:** WAPE 19.9% on 693 rows.
